target: cETH supply->accrue-gap->redeem single-transaction cycle (capture of exchange-rate growth for supplied dust; non-holder redesign after the accrue caller-cash premise closed)
why: No entry pays cash to a zero-position accrue caller on the deployed cETH layout (attempts 529/530/531): the accrued interest arrives only as exchange-rate growth for cETH holders, and the measured payouts were holders redeeming their own positions. The only remaining free-ish angle: supply a small ETH amount into cETH, hold it across one accrue gap (gaps >= 1000 blocks on the accrual clock occurred 12 times in 7 d, last profitable accrue block 26364053), then redeem - the gain is the rate growth accrued during the held gap, realized atomically if supply+redeem run in one pair of calls with a min-gain guard. Nobody does this here from a zero position today (the incumbent hygiene keepers only accrue, the big holders exited). Measured 2026-11-08 run 6429cafda (relay research lane): debug_traceCall zero-position probes (db006a75 executes, pays 0; 852a12e3 transfers value then reverts insufficient); payout-tx keepers' cETH balances today 1996/0/0; trace of 0x256174a0 shows share transfers, no value.
